subject: reasoning
question:
Select the dice that can be formed by folding the given sheet along the lines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38d9e8dfeedd49a2f1cc94d80d7db2e575fae2c01a7fc47dfd10e2d2bf8054da.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3988ea07388ffa0f865c69d0fe200f6d240c7a55d3fececa36ae6b0d9233b4fa.png]
solution:
Opposite surface of the open dice can be found by the below method:-

__
 
• Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other.
 
• No two opposite surface are touched by side or by corners

So, by using the above rule we can find the opposite surface of open dice.

In the given figure, Opposite faces are :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61910a40df0dd0c41eb1b524d078f512542fe9406186d11c671adfec23603586.png] 

 
 

 **Alphabets**
 **Opposite faces**
 
 

 P
 R
 
 

 Q
 S
 
 

 T
 U
 
 

 

 
• Note :- Two opposite face are never seen together or adjacent to each other.

Given :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3988ea07388ffa0f865c69d0fe200f6d240c7a55d3fececa36ae6b0d9233b4fa.png] 

In figure (A) : None of the opposite faces are seen together nor they are adjacent to each other so, This cube can be formed.

In figure (B) : None of the opposite faces are seen together nor they are adjacent to each other so, This cube can be formed.

In figure (C) : None of the opposite faces are seen together nor they are adjacent to each other so, This cube can be formed.

In figure (D) : None of the opposite faces are seen together nor they are adjacent to each other, but here R should be the left side of U for forming the cube. **So, this cube can't be formed.**

∴ Here,** All figures A, B and C cubes can be formed.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"A, B and C".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] Mistake Points__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c73bcb8c00dbf71bd5a677b0477cce7c1ac92b6ea7588a185f325baa94ecce79.png] - U can not be placed at the right side of S in a cube, so Cube D can not be made from the given open dice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0544e7fff49f3a105730c6a17efdf16349e6625e07f580c2d334f610b1e773b.png] - This cube can't be made, because R is placed at the left of U,

it should be **R** placed to be right of **U** for framing a cube [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80057264105875a5503ad21a94317a7fac986b52655cb63068f0b33189e18b05.png] .
